subject: Failed autopay — request for split-billing plan and acquirer evidence
messages:
From: Sima Patel <sima@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 15:12:34 -0700
Subject: Failed autopay for Invoice #3378 — need VAT breakout & next steps

Hi Neha,

Our finance team ran the scheduled autopay for invoice #3378 this morning but the payment failed at the acquirer layer. Stripe shows a generic decline (code: acq_decline) and they have placed the settlement on hold until we provide additional evidence.

We're trying to avoid a manual refund/chargeback cycle — our accounts payable asked whether Redwood can:
- split the invoice into two line items (service vs. VAT) so VAT can be settled through our local tax agent,
- provide the acquirer evidence bundle (merchant descriptor, refund policy, and invoice PDF) to speed up reconciliation, and
- schedule a retry window where we can keep the same payment method but attempt SCA fallback if required.

Attached: invoice_3378.pdf and a brief decline report exported from Stripe.

Can you confirm what evidence Redwood can share and whether a split-billing approach is possible for this invoice? We need a VAT breakout in the next 48 hours to keep our quarter-end close on track.

Thanks,
Sima
Head of Finance
Orbit Analytics

---
attachment: invoice_3378.pdf (application/pdf)
attachment: stripe-decline-report-3378.csv (text/csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sima Patel <sima@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:23:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed autopay for Invoice #3378 — need VAT breakout & next steps

Hi Sima — thanks for the details and for attaching the decline report. I pulled internal notes: Stripe labeled the event as an "acquirer decline" which usually means the issuing bank flagged the transaction or acquirer asked for more documentation.

Quick answers up front:
1) Split billing: yes, we can issue a corrected invoice that separates taxable service lines from VAT so your tax agent can reconcile locally. It will be a new invoice number that references #3378; amounts and remit instructions will match.
2) Evidence bundle: we can provide a merchant evidence packet (merchant descriptor, signed contract excerpt, invoice PDF, refund policy) — I will coordinate that with Finance and CS.
3) Retry window: we can schedule a retry attempt on a specific date and enable SCA fallback (3DS) if Stripe prompts it. If the acquirer maintains the hold, we will escalate to Stripe merchant support.

Next steps I propose:
- By EOD tomorrow (Tue 2025-09-16) we will send: a split invoice draft + VAT breakout spreadsheet for your tax team to confirm.
- Also by EOD tomorrow we'll upload the evidence bundle to Stripe and loop in Stripe support if the acquirer requires additional docs.
- Tentative retry window: Thu 2025-09-18 08:00–12:00 UTC (we'll coordinate with you before the attempt).

Ben / Priya — can you prepare the VAT breakout (use the attached template) and the evidence bundle? Priya, please own the upload to Stripe and ping me when done so I can confirm with Sima and schedule the retry.

Neha
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:05:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed autopay for Invoice #3378 — prep: VAT breakout + evidence upload

Adding checklist and owners. I'll own the Stripe upload and.trace. Ben — can you generate the VAT breakout per-country lines and confirm taxable base? Marissa — please extract the contractual excerpt and refund policy; we should include the signed SOW page.

Checklist (ETA EOD Tue 2025-09-16):
- VAT breakout spreadsheet (ben) — use vat_breakdown_template.xlsx and include tax rate references.
- Evidence packet (marissa) — signed SOW, merchant descriptor, invoice PDF, company registration docs (redacted).
- Decline narrative (priya) — short note for Stripe that explains attempted autopay and that customer authorizes retry.
- Upload to Stripe and create a support case linking the evidence (priya).

Also note: if acquirer explicitly requests proof of cardholder consent or billing descriptor, we need to include a screenshot of the billing email/UI that shows the subscription/product name. I can pull that from the Console.

Priya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 13:42:19 +0100
Subject: Re: Failed autopay for Invoice #3378 — need VAT breakout & next steps

Thanks — attaching the purchase order and our tax certificate. Our payment team also confirmed the card on file is a UK corporate card (Visa ending 4321). They asked whether Redwood can attempt a rebill using SCA fallback; they are prepared to approve the 3DS challenge.

Please note: Orbit's finance will escalate to our issuing bank if we don't get a settlement window by Thursday — we'd like Redwood to attempt the retry on the agreed date and to share the evidence upload reference so we can confirm with the acquirer.

Attached: orbit_po_8892.pdf, orbit_tax_certificate.pdf

Sima

Subject: Evidence upload + request for acquirer confirmation — payment pay_1JY... (invoice 3378)

Hello Stripe Team,

We have uploaded an evidence bundle for payment pay_1JY... tied to invoice #3378 (customer: Orbit Analytics). The acquirer flagged the transaction as an "acquirer decline" and is requesting documentation to approve settlement.

Files uploaded: merchant_descriptor.txt, signed_sow_3378.pdf, invoice_3378_split_vat.pdf, vat_breakdown_template_filled.xlsx, decline_narrative.txt

Customer has authorized a retry and is willing to complete SCA if prompted (they are a UK corporate card). Please confirm:
- whether the acquirer has everything they need to release settlement, and
- if a retry attempt on Thu 2025-09-18 09:00 UTC would be processed with SCA fallback available.

Stripe case: polite request to route to acquirer investigations. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/98214 — please reference.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Stripe responded this morning: acquirer is reviewing and asked for one additional item — a screenshot of the billing confirmation email that shows the product descriptor. Marissa pulled that and it's in the bundle (billing_confirm.png).

Orbit finance confirmed they will allow SCA flow for the retry. Let's proceed with the retry window of Thu 2025-09-18 09:00 UTC. I'll monitor the attempt and ping Sima when we see the authorization hit.

Ben
